brief:
The Palestinian Petroleum Authority in Gaza announced Sunday the arrival of five truckloads of cooking gas, according to Shehab Wire. The shipment marks one of the limited fuel deliveries reaching the territory, where acute shortages of essential supplies have persisted for months.

Gaza has faced severe constraints on fuel imports, with cooking gas in particularly short supply as the civilian population struggles to meet basic needs. The authority did not disclose the source of the shipment or specify how the gas would be distributed among residents and institutions across the enclave.
